codename: Everyday Compound Word Joining & Subordinating Clause Splitting
notes: Rejoins everyday compound words ('down town' -> 'downtown', 'book store' -> 'bookstore', 'book stores' -> 'bookstores') and improves clause-break candidate selection in _split_completed_sentences and _split_final_paragraph on subordinating and comparative conjunctions ('than', 'because', 'where', 'when', 'which', 'though', 'although') when preceded by >= 10 words.
